features.name: Example use case from the chassis
features.behavior: backend/ runs the ai-app-chassis example: POST /summarize with guardrails, PII redaction, a versioned prompt and structured output, GET /usage and GET /health, on the fake model by default.
features.verification: npm run check passes, including the coverage and eval-summarize quality gates.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix ruff/format or harness lint errors and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 1b: Type checks
layers.repair: Fix mypy errors in backend/src and rerun.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Fix failing tests and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Resolve remaining issues and rerun full verification.

layers.label: Layer 4: Quality gates
layers.repair: Raise coverage or the eval score back above the floor in .harness/quality.json.
